name: Sparse Voxel Octree Path Tracing
definition: A rendering technique that traverses a Sparse Voxel Octree structure on the CPU to perform path tracing, writing results to a texture displayed via OpenGL.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Path Tracing is a CPU-based technique that efficiently renders complex voxel scenes by traversing a sparse octree to skip empty space and integrate Monte Carlo path tracing with Russian roulette termination.
